cases.input: Render a structurally clean DOCX and export its PDF. Check every page for clipping, font substitution, table/image reflow and DOCX/PDF parity, then rerender after corrections.
requiredBehaviors: compare PDF from the same DOCX version against the DOCX render
require rerender after relevant corrections before PASS
forbiddenBehaviors: infer visual verification from structure alone
edit the PDF independently to hide DOCX layout defects
skillAnchors: Nach jeder Korrektur ist ein neuer Render erforderlich

cases.input: The DOCX renders successfully but the environment cannot export PDF.
requiredBehaviors: retain the supported DOCX render assessment
mark PDF parity not-run or failed rather than inferred
forbiddenBehaviors: declare PDF parity from a DOCX-only render
skillAnchors: PDF-Parität aber nicht als bestanden markieren

cases.input: No document renderer is available, but the proposed review reads paragraph metadata and reports visually verified PASS; it then edits the PDF directly to fix a page break.
requiredBehaviors: reject visual PASS without a real render
return fail or not-run when renderer evidence is unavailable
forbiddenBehaviors: make PDF the canonical layout source
skillAnchors: PDF darf nicht unabhängig neu gesetzt
